dataset.citation: Schmidt HB et al. Oxaliplatin disrupts nucleolar function through biophysical disintegration. Cell Reports 2022. doi:10.1016/j.celrep.2022.111629
dataset.scope: U2OS cells with endogenous FBL-sfGFP and NPM1-mTagRFP knock-ins, 1 h untreated or Oxaliplatin 10 µM, then a 30 min 5-EU pulse labelled with Alexa Fluor 647 azide; Hoechst nuclear stain. Olympus IX83 widefield, 40x/1.4 oil, 0.1625 um/px, single plane, uint16 OME-TIFF.
dataset.modifications: 640 x 640 crop of each 2304 x 2304 plane, placed where the Hoechst stain covers the most area (the same window for all channels); channels Hoechst (OME c3), NPM1-mTagRFP (OME c1) and 5-EU (OME c2, Cy5); pixel values unchanged; re-saved as uncompressed single-plane TIFF.
caveats: 出典は、オキサリプラチンで核小体の離心率が下がる（丸くなる）と報告しています。測定の前に決めた定義（各回の最初の 3 視野）で比べたこのデモでは、離心率の差（オキサリプラチン − 未処理）は −0.018、−0.022、+0.015 で、2 回は出典と同じ向き、1 回は逆でした。核あたりの核小体の総面積は 3 回とも小さく（−17%、−17%、−46%）、核小体の平均 5-EU は向きがそろいません（+32%、+64%、−13%）。統計の「記録した比較」で切り替えて確かめられます。小さい物体ほど離心率は低く出やすいので、離心率は総面積と合わせて読んでください。各群 9 視野・核小体のある核 65〜84 個の小さい標本で、出典（各条件 713 個以上の核小体）より少なく、結果は例示です。論文の 5-EU は核小体の面積あたり・核小体ごとの値で、デモの核小体の平均 5-EU（核ごと、背景補正なし）とは定義が異なります。
Rep1–Rep3 は同じ日（2021-12-01）に連番で撮影されています。独立した実験であることは出典で確認できないため、この場面では推測統計を行いません。
各反復・各条件で、ファイル名の順に最初の 3 視野を使います。各画像から 640 × 640 画素（104 µm 角）を、核染色（Hoechst）が最も多く写る位置で切り出しています（NPM1 と 5-EU は見ていません）。視野は数・大きさ・信号で選んでいません。
核小体は NPM1 の分布から決めます。
核小体を確定できない核は、核から消さずに欠測として残しています（要件 Q-05）。統計を計算する前に群・実験回・理由ごとの一覧で確かめ、結果の近くに、群・実験回ごとの核の総数と欠測の数を示します。同じ実験回の中で群の欠測の割合が 10 ポイント以上違うときは警告します。値は核小体を確定できた核についてのもので、欠測による偏りを補正した推定ではありません。
論文の図の 5-EU は核小体の面積あたり・核小体ごとの値で、デモの核小体の平均 5-EU（核ごと）とは単位と正規化が異なります。
デモの数値は公開画像による例示で、研究室の画像での妥当性を示すものではありません。
デモのAI解析案は、例文に対して用意した設定案を返します（外部AIは呼び出しません）。

reported_change.source: Schmidt ら 2022、Cell Reports、Figure 5A–B と本文：“we detected a comparable nucleolar 5-EU signal (normalized to nucleolar area) in oxaliplatin-treated cells despite a decrease in nucleolar eccentricity”。Figure 1：臨床濃度（約 10 µM）のオキサリプラチンで、核小体（FBL と NPM1）が丸くなる
reported_change.comparison: 未処理と オキサリプラチン（1 時間）の後、5-EU を 30 分取り込ませた U2OS
reported_change.direction: オキサリプラチンで核小体が丸くなる（離心率が下がる）。核小体の 5-EU（面積あたり）は未処理と同程度で、1 時間では転写はまだ続いている
reported_change.quantity: 論文は箱ひげ図（各条件 713 個以上の核小体）で示す。図 5B の各条件の濃度は図の中にあり、本文は「oxaliplatin」とだけ書く。デモは臨床濃度の 10 µM（ファイル名 Ox10）を比べる
reported_change.scope: 核小体は NPM1 で決め、5-EU は別のチャンネルで測ります。論文の図の 5-EU は核小体の面積あたり（著者のコードでは NPM1 で割った値）で、デモの平均 5-EU とは定義が異なります。
reported_change.independence: Rep1–Rep3 は同じ日に連番で撮影されており、独立した実験であることは出典で確認できません。このため、この場面では検定をせず、群ごとの分布と実験回ごとの値を示します。

explainer.what: ヒト骨肉腫細胞（U2OS）。オキサリプラチン 10 µM を 1 時間処理し、無処理と比較。
explainer.colors: 重ね表示：青＝核（Hoechst）、緑＝核小体（NPM1）、黄＝新生 RNA（5-EU）。線＝検出した輪郭。
explainer.finding: 核小体の総面積は 3 回とも減少。離心率の変化は回により不一致。

scenes.derivation_rule: Pre-registered on 2026-11-12, before any field of Ox10 was read: for Untreated and Ox10, the first three files of each replicate Rep1–Rep3 in file-name order (the rule of zenodo-6643470-nucleolar.json, the same Untreated files). Each plane is cropped to 640 x 640 pixels by crop_rule, chosen from the nuclear stain alone. Channels: Hoechst (c3), NPM1 (c1), 5-EU (c2). No field is selected or removed by its count, size or signal.

selection.rule: first three files per replicate and condition in file-name order; crop by crop_rule

scenario_notes.unit_definition: 反復（Rep1–Rep3。独立性は出典で確認できない）
scenario_notes.pairing_basis: 同じ反復（Rep）の未処理と Oxaliplatin 10 µM
scenario_notes.grid_notes: Nuclei: StarDist probability and NMS grid on all fields. Nucleoli: the stable nucleolar-marker definition (cytellect-nucleolar-v2) on NPM1 runs in the browser for any nuclear result. Cellpose-SAM is not recorded.
scenario_notes.comparison_plan: Planned on 2026-11-12, before any Ox10 value was read: Untreated versus oxaliplatin 10 µM (file-name condition Ox10, the clinically relevant concentration of Figure 1; Figure 5B's concentrations are printed in the figure and not in its legend). Opening comparison: the nucleolar eccentricity per nucleus (compartment summary), paired by replicate; companions: the nucleolar area and the nucleolar mean 5-EU. Expected direction from the source: lower eccentricity with oxaliplatin; the nucleolar 5-EU per area comparable to untreated at 1 h. No inferential test, because the replicates' independence is not established.

implications: 離心率の変化は実験回で向きが一致せず、本条件では核小体の形態変化を判断できない。
一部の回では離心率が低下しており、形態変化の初期段階である可能性は残る。
alternatives: 視野数が少なく、核間のばらつきが小さな変化を覆っている可能性がある。
実験回の独立性が未確認で、回間差が処理の効果か撮影条件の差かを区別できない。
next_steps: 視野数と実験回を増やし、差の向きの一致を確認する。
同一核で核小体の総面積・数と併せて解析し、形態と大きさの変化を分離する。
処理時間を延長し、形態変化の経時的な推移を調べる。

experiment.independence_basis: Not confirmed by the source: Rep1–Rep3 were imaged on the same date in one numbered sequence.

Each plane is cropped to 640 x 640 pixels (for the published seed size) by crop_rule (see derivation_amendment). Channels: Hoechst (c3), NPM1 (c1), 5-EU (c2). No field is selected or removed by its count, size or signal. Objects are removed only by the fragment review (scenario.fragment_review, see derivation_amendment): an object whose nucleolus is not established and whose area is below 0.6 of its field's median nuclear area. The rule reads area only; it does not test contact with the crop border.
scenes.derivation_amendment: Amended after the first scenario run, before any nucleolar or 5-EU value was read: the pre-registered centre crops held 0-2 nuclei in four of the 18 fields (Rep1 ActD file 52, Rep2 ActD file 112, Rep3 Untreated files 121 and 122); in Rep3 Untreated file 122 the crop held no nucleus and StarDist returned 51 objects in the cytoplasm, which left the field's nucleolar compartments unresolved and stopped the build. The crop position is now chosen per field from the nuclear stain alone (crop_rule). The 18 files, channels, groups, runs and every later rule are unchanged; no field is removed. Second amendment, after the re-cropped scenario run and before any nucleolar or 5-EU value was read: three objects had no established nucleolus (all three lay at the crop border on the overlay; the rule itself reads area only) (152, 2079 and 3222 px; 0.03, 0.49 and 0.58 of their field's median nuclear area), which leaves those fields' compartments unresolved. The build's existing fragment review (scenario.fragment_review, used by the earlier public demo of this dataset) is applied: an unresolved object smaller than 0.6 of its field's median nuclear area is deleted from the nuclei, as the workspace's region deletion does, and listed in manifest.json (scenario.fragment_review); any larger unresolved nucleus stops the build. Third amendment, 2026-10-26 by the owner (requirements Q-05, genellect/cytellect#109), after this scene's 5-EU and eccentricity results had been read: the fragment review is withdrawn from this scene. The product's policy for nuclei without an established nucleolus (unresolved-as-missing/1.0.0, decided for all data and not from this scene's values) replaces it: such nuclei stay in the nuclei and, in each nucleolar statistic, in the ledger as missing, confirmed by group, run and reason before the calculation, with all nuclei as the denominator and a warning when the groups' missing fractions differ by 10 percentage points or more within a run. The 18 files, crops, channels, metrics and comparison plan are unchanged. Results recorded under the fragment review keep that definition and replay unchanged.

selection.rule: first three files per replicate and condition in file-name order; crop by crop_rule

scenario_notes.unit_definition: 反復（Rep1–Rep3。独立性は出典で確認できない）
scenario_notes.pairing_basis: 同じ反復（Rep）の未処理と ActD
scenario_notes.grid_notes: Nuclei: StarDist probability and NMS grid on all fields. Nucleoli: the stable nucleolar-marker definition (cytellect-nucleolar-v2) on NPM1 runs in the browser for any nuclear result. Cellpose-SAM is not recorded.
scenario_notes.comparison_plan: Planned before measurement: per-field distributions of the nucleolar mean 5-EU (raw and background-corrected) and of the nucleolar eccentricity (compartment-summary 1.1.0), Untreated versus ActD 1 µM, by replicate. Expected directions from the source: lower nucleolar 5-EU and lower eccentricity with ActD. No inferential test is reported because the replicates' independence is not established. Amended before any value was read (2026-10-25): the common statistics gained a descriptive comparison (test none) for designs whose independence is unconfirmed; the scene opens on that comparison of the nucleolar mean 5-EU (per-run values and differences, no test, p-value or interval). Result as planned (2026-10-25): ActD − untreated nucleolar mean 5-EU per run +263, −83, −1317 (Rep1–3), not the direction the paper reports; the paper's EU/NPM1 per nucleolus differs in definition and aggregation. An exploratory nucleoplasm/nucleolus 5-EU ratio examined after this result is not published; the scene keeps the planned metric.
scenario_notes.presentation_amendment: Presentation amended 2026-10-26 by the owner (goals C7), after the planned result was read and without changing any metric, rule or field: the scene shows both changes the source reports and the plan recorded before measurement. The opening comparison stays the nucleolar mean 5-EU (its directions do not match the source); the nucleolar eccentricity, planned as the second readout, is saved as a companion comparison beside it. The build checks each recorded direction against the scene's text (direction_checks) and stops when they disagree. The source's EU/NPM1 per nucleolus is not added after the fact.

implications: RNA 合成の阻害により、新生 RNA の核小体への集積が失われた可能性がある。
核小体の 5-EU 平均は実験回で増減が一致せず、量的な変化は判断できない。
alternatives: 5-EU が核全体に分散すると、核小体内の平均値では分布の変化を捉えにくい。
next_steps: 核質／核小体の 5-EU 比を比較し、分布の変化として評価する。
5-EU の標識時間を変え、合成阻害の時間経過を調べる。

experiment.independence_basis: Not confirmed by the source: Rep1–Rep3 were imaged on the same date in one numbered sequence.

dataset.name: JUMP Cell Painting, cpg0016 source_13 CRISPR plates (Cell Painting Gallery)
dataset.license_quoted: Cell Painting Gallery README: "All the data is released with CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)."
dataset.attribution: Images: JUMP Cell Painting Consortium, Cell Painting Gallery cpg0016-jump, source_13 (CC0 1.0); plates CP-CC9-R1-01, CP-CC9-R2-01, CP-CC9-R3-01, sites 4-6 of wells A02 and A23; DNA channel only.
dataset.citation: Chandrasekaran SN et al. Morphological map of under- and overexpression of genes in human cells. Nature Methods 22, 1742-1752 (2025). doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02753-9
dataset.scope: U2OS-311 (Cas9) cells, 96 h after transfection with pooled CRISPR guides; Cell Painting. Yokogawa CV7000, confocal, NA 0.75, 0.65 um/px (JUMP microscope_config.csv), 1280 x 1080 px, single plane, uint16 TIFF. Channel: Hoechst 33342 (DNA, C01).
dataset.modifications: None to pixel values or image size (1280 x 1080): one of the five channels (DNA) is used, re-saved as an uncompressed single-plane TIFF.
caveats: Run1–Run3 は、バッチ 20220914_Run1、20221009_Run2、20221017_Run3 のプレート CP-CC9-R1-01、R2-01、R3-01 です。出典は各プレートを播種から 96 時間で固定したと述べていますが、別々に播種・導入・染色した独立した実験であるとは明記していません。日付から独立性を推定しないため、デモでは独立性を未確認として扱い、検定をしません。
日付はバッチ名の日付です。撮影日かどうかは出典に書かれていません。
各実験回・各条件で 1 ウェル 3 視野（3 × 3 の中央の行、視野 4〜6）です。ウェルは公開されたプレート配置の対照 A02（non-targeting）と A23（PLK1）です。視野は核の数や値で選んでいません。比較は実験回ごとの値と差による記述です。
核数は視野に写った核の数で、生存率や増殖率そのものではありません。PLK1 のノックアウトでは大きく不規則な核や、断片化した核の塊も見え、塊は小さな物体に分かれて検出・計数されることがあります。両群に同じ検出を当て、物体の大きさによる除外はしていません。デモでは核の形を解釈しません。
デモの数値は公開画像による例示で、研究室の画像での妥当性を示すものではありません。
デモのAI解析案は、例文に対して用意した設定案を返します（外部AIは呼び出しません）。

reported_change.source: Chandrasekaran ら 2025、Nature Methods、Methods「Within-plate controls」：“CRISPR plates – PLK1; knocking it down kills cells.”
reported_change.comparison: 同じプレートの PLK1 ノックアウトと non-targeting（標的のないガイド）
reported_change.direction: PLK1 のノックアウトで細胞が死ぬ（視野の核が減る）
reported_change.quantity: 出典は向きだけを述べ、視野あたりの核数の変化量は報告していません
reported_change.scope: 核は Hoechst から数えます。核数は画像に写った核の数で、生存率そのものではありません。値は視野 → 試料 → 実験回の順にまとめています。
reported_change.independence: Run1–Run3 は日付の異なるバッチの別のプレートです。出典は各プレートを播種から 96 時間で固定したと述べていますが、別々に播種・導入・染色した独立した実験であるとは明記していません。このため、この場面では検定と信頼区間を計算せず、実験回ごとの値と差を示します。

explainer.what: ヒト骨肉腫細胞（U2OS）。CRISPR で PLK1 をノックアウトし、非標的ガイドの対照と比較。
explainer.finding: 視野あたりの核数は 3 回とも大きく減少。分裂に必須の遺伝子の欠失で細胞が増えないことと整合。

scenes.derivation_rule: Pre-registered before any measurement (this manifest is committed before the scenario runs). Plates: the first replicate plate map CP-CC9-R1/R2/R3-01 of source_13, one per batch Run1, Run2, Run3 (the first three batches). Wells: A02 (non-targeting, JCP2022_800002) and A23 (PLK1, JCP2022_805264), the row-A controls of plate-map columns 2 and 23 (JUMP metadata well.csv.gz and crispr.csv.gz). Site: 5 (F005, the centre of the 3 x 3 sites), for every well (amended to sites 4-6, see derivation_amendment). Channels: DNA and RNA. No field, nucleus or object is chosen or removed by its count, size or signal. Before this rule was fixed, site 2 of A02 and A23 on CP-CC9-R1-01 and CP-CC9-R3-01 was viewed to confirm that the images are available and show the reported change; site 5 was not viewed or measured before the rule was committed.
scenes.derivation_amendment: Amendment recorded before publication: the approved requirement D-08 asks for at least three fields per group and run, so sites 4 and 6 (with site 5 the centre row of the 3 x 3 sites; F004-F006 in the published file names) were added for every well. The site-5 nuclei-per-field result (Run1-Run3: 471/244/376 non-targeting, 37/44/45 PLK1) had been computed before this amendment; the added sites are fixed by position only, not by any measured value, and no site is removed. The comparison plan is unchanged.

selection.rule: fixed plates, wells and site; no measurement-based selection

scenario_notes.unit_definition: 実験回（Run1–Run3。日付の異なるバッチの別のプレート）
scenario_notes.pairing_basis: 同じ実験回（プレート）の対照と PLK1 ノックアウト
scenario_notes.design_note: Each run (plate) contains both conditions, so conditions are paired by run: experimental unit = one condition within one run, pair = run. Independence of the runs is unconfirmed, so the comparison is descriptive (no test).
scenario_notes.grid_notes: Nuclei: full 3 x 3 grid of StarDist probability (0.4/0.5/0.6) and NMS (0.2/0.3/0.4) at the automatic detection scale on all fields. Nucleoli are not detected: at 0.65 um/px the dataset is not suited to nucleolar segmentation, so the nucleolar and nucleoplasm views are not offered. Cellpose-SAM cell ROI is not recorded.
scenario_notes.comparison_plan: Planned before measurement: nuclei per field (field-summary 1.0.0, StarDist nuclei on Hoechst with default settings, nuclei touching the border included), PLK1 KO − non-targeting, paired by run, paired t-test, comparison estimates (difference and geometric-mean ratio with 95% intervals). Expected direction from the source: fewer nuclei after PLK1 knockout. No threshold on the effect size is set; a result in the other direction will be reported as such. Amended before publication at the owner's decision (2026-10-25): the runs' independence is unconfirmed (requirements E-05), so the comparison is descriptive (common statistics test none): per-run values and differences, no test, p-value or interval; the planned association is not computed.
scenario_notes.presentation_amendment: Presentation amended 2026-10-26 by the owner, after the scene was published: the display comparing the adopted nuclei with the CellProfiler objects JUMP published for the same images is withdrawn, because its purpose was not clear to visitors. It was display only; no field, rule, measurement or comparison changes, and the planned comparison (nuclei per field) is unchanged.

implications: PLK1 の欠失で視野あたりの細胞数が全実験回で減少しており、PLK1 の増殖への必要性と整合する。
alternatives: 細胞死による減少か増殖停止によるものかは、核数のみでは区別できない。
実験回の独立性が未確認で、回間のばらつきを過小評価している可能性がある。
next_steps: 分裂期と細胞死のマーカーで、細胞数減少の機序を調べる。
別のガイド配列で再現性を確認し、ガイド依存の効果を除く。
